settings.name: PDP Dialect
settings.description: Which PDP the processor asks: the PingAuthorize governance engine, or an OpenID AuthZEN 1.0 PDP (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Anything but authzen, in any case, is the governance engine

settings.name: PDP URL
settings.description: The PDP's decision URL (for authzen, its /access/v1/evaluation); required, https unless OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development, and the console's https:// placeholder is refused (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Blank, not a URL, or http outside development: the admin console and API refuse it on save; an archive import runs no validator, so the instance fails to configure and refuses every request that reaches it

settings.name: PDP Domain Prefix
settings.description: The governance-engine domain a detail is decided under, as <prefix>.<type>; the governance-engine dialect only. The default is the console's; a stored configuration without the field (from the admin API or an archive) reads as empty (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Read as given; a domain the PDP's policy does not know is denied

settings.name: PDP Service
settings.description: The governance-engine service named in each decision request; the governance-engine dialect only (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Read as given, blank meaning the default; a service the PDP does not know is denied

settings.name: PDP Action
settings.description: The governance-engine action named in each decision request; the governance-engine dialect only (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Read as given, blank meaning the default; an action the PDP does not know is denied

settings.name: Attribute Prefix
settings.description: The prefix on the attribute names the processor sends the PDP. The default is the console's; a stored configuration without the field (from the admin API or an archive) reads as empty (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Read as given; empty, with Prefix Attributes with Type off, a requested field can reach a reserved name, and that request is refused

settings.name: Prefix Attributes with Type
settings.description: Whether each attribute name also carries the detail's type; a stored configuration without the field reads as on (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: A checkbox: PingFederate stores true or false

settings.name: Shared Secret Header
settings.description: The request header that carries the shared secret to the PDP (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Blank: the default. A header the PDP does not read: it answers 401 or 403, and every request is denied, never failed open

settings.name: Shared Secret
settings.description: The secret sent to the PDP in the shared-secret header; required, and stored encrypted under PingFederate's master key (a value an older jar stored in the clear still works until re-saved) (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: the PDP answers 401 or 403, and every request is denied, never failed open

settings.name: Types requiring an authenticated principal
settings.description: The detail types refused before any PDP call unless the decision is about a person PingFederate authenticated (principal_source none or client is refused); comma- or space-separated, and a single - means none (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Read as given; blank is the default, and - lets these types be decided about a client or nobody

settings.name: Fail open on engine error
settings.description: Whether a request goes ahead without the PDP's narrowing when the PDP is unreachable (connection refused or reset, name unresolved, connect or total deadline, all 32 call places taken until the deadline, the circuit breaker open, HTTP 429, 502, 503 or 504); any other answer, a malformed or oversized one and a TLS failure still deny, and the model's checks come first either way (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: On in production without pdp-fail-open in OIDF_ACCEPTED_RISKS: refused on save, and at configure after an archive import, when the instance refuses every request. PingFederate stores true or false; missing reads as off

settings.name: Trust a client-asserted principal
settings.description: Whether login_hint or _principal_sub becomes the decision's subject when no principal is known, so the caller chooses who the decision is about; honoured only with OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development and refused elsewhere, and gone at 1.0 (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: On in production: refused on save, and at configure after an archive import, when the instance refuses every request. PingFederate stores true or false; missing reads as off

settings.name: Trust the PAR-carried agent marker
settings.description: Whether, where the attestation is not in the request (the authorization endpoint), the agent instance comes from the _agent_id the attestation filter put in each entry at PAR; only for clients that must use PAR (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: A checkbox: PingFederate stores true or false; missing reads as off

settings.name: Skip TLS verification (dev only)
settings.description: Whether any PDP certificate is trusted; honoured only with OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development and refused elsewhere, and the certificate must still name the PDP URL's host either way: platform's client always checks it (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: On in production: refused on save, and at configure after an archive import, when the instance refuses every request. PingFederate stores true or false; missing reads as off

settings.name: Request timeout (ms)
settings.description: The PDP call's total deadline in milliseconds, from connecting (at most 1 s of it) to the last byte of the answer, held to 1000-10000; a call past it counts as the PDP being unreachable, so with Fail open on engine error on, a deadline shorter than the PDP's answer lets every request through without the PDP's narrowing (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, or 0 or less: 2500, without a word; below 1000 or above 10000: held to the nearest. Too short, with Fail open on engine error on: every request fails open

settings.name: OIDF_RAR_EXTRA_TYPES
settings.description: More authorization_details types PingFederate may bind to the processor, beyond sales_agent, payment_initiation and account_information, space- or comma-separated; read from the plugin descriptor at start-up, before any instance is configured, so not an instance field. A type needs a model too (rar-models): named here without one it is refused in production

when_wrong.detail: Read as given, comma- or space-separated; a type named here that no model names is refused (UNMODELLED_TYPE) on every request

settings.name: PDP TLS trust
settings.description: How the PDP's certificate is trusted: jvm-default (the JVM's CA certificates), pingfederate-trusted-cas (PingFederate's trusted CAs, which include the JVM's, read through the SDK's TrustedCAAccessor on each call) or pinned-ca (only the CA certificates in PDP CA certificates (PEM)); the certificate must name the PDP URL's host in every mode (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: A value that is none of the three: the admin console and API refuse it on save; an archive import runs no validator, so the instance fails to configure and refuses every request that reaches it. A PDP certificate the mode does not trust, or one that does not name the host: every request is denied, never failed open

settings.name: PDP CA certificates (PEM)
settings.description: The CA certificates, PEM, that the PDP's certificate must chain to when PDP TLS trust is pinned-ca; ignored in the other modes (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Blank or not a PEM certificate with pinned-ca: refused on save, and at configure after an archive import, when the instance refuses every request

settings.name: AuthZEN batch URL
settings.description: authzen dialect only: the PDP's Access Evaluations URL (/access/v1/evaluations, OpenID AuthZEN Authorization API 1.0 section 7); when set, the first detail of a token request sends every detail the request carries in one evaluations call, and the rest are answered from it. Blank: one call per detail; https unless OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Set with the governance-engine dialect, not a URL, or http outside development: refused on save, and at configure after an archive import. A PDP that answers fewer or more evaluations than it was asked: every detail of that request is denied

settings.name: Decision cache types
settings.description: Detail types whose PDP decisions may be reused for up to Decision cache TTL (s), keyed on the canonical detail, the principal, the client, the attester and the RAR model set; comma- or space-separated, blank means none. payment_initiation and every type in Types requiring an authenticated principal are refused (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Naming payment_initiation or a type requiring an authenticated principal: refused on save, and at configure after an archive import. A type named here is decided from a decision up to the TTL old: a policy change reaches it that much later

settings.name: Decision cache TTL (s)
settings.description: How long a cached decision is reused, in seconds, from 1 to 60 (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Outside 1-60 or not a whole number: refused on save, and at configure after an archive import

settings.name: Circuit breaker failures
settings.description: Transport failures in a row (the PDP unreachable, as Fail open on engine error counts it) after which the circuit breaker opens: while open the PDP is not called and every decision counts as unreachable; a 4xx, a malformed answer or a TLS failure never counts (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Outside 1-1000 or not a whole number: refused on save, and at configure after an archive import

settings.name: Circuit breaker open (s)
settings.description: Seconds the circuit breaker stays open before it lets one trial call through; the trial's success closes it, its failure opens it again (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Outside 1-3600 or not a whole number: refused on save, and at configure after an archive import

settings.name: Types allowed on the JWT-bearer grant
settings.description: Detail types a JWT-bearer token request (RFC 7523) may carry; comma- or space-separated, blank means none, and a type not listed is refused by validate with invalid_authorization_details. PingFederate never calls enrich on that grant, so a listed type passes validate's model check and is issued without a PDP decision. Never a type in Types requiring an authenticated principal (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Naming a type in Types requiring an authenticated principal: refused on save, and at configure after an archive import. A type named here is issued on the JWT-bearer grant without a PDP decision

settings.name: AuthZEN context members merged into details
settings.description: authzen dialect only: per detail type, the members of a decision's context (and of context.statements, by the first part of each name) that may be merged into the granted detail, as type: member, member entries separated by ; or new lines; @model is every member the type's model declares, - none. A type not named merges nothing, so payment_initiation merges nothing by default; a member not named is dropped, counted in oidf_rar_context_dropped_total and logged by name, never merged; a named member that would widen the detail is still refused (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize")

when_wrong.detail: Not type: member entries, a type named twice, a member with a dot, or type, _principal_sub or _agent_id listed: refused on save, and at configure after an archive import. A member the PDP enriches through and the field leaves out: dropped, and the detail is granted without it
